title: Why Modi used crime of female foeticide to attack Opposition and what it signals
desc: PM Narendra Modi compared the Opposition's defeating the bill to reserve seats for women to female foeticide. The use of foeticide sharpens the messaging, adds a grisly imagery, and associates the Opposition with a hideous crime.

title: Four people rescued from boat fire off Dún Laoghaire
desc: Four people have been rescued from a boat that caught fire in Dún Laoghaire harbour.

title: Powerful winds and reported tornadoes rip through the Midwest, leaving heavy damage but no deaths
desc: A trail of damaged homes and buildings dotted a wide swath of the U.S. on Saturday after a burst of destructive winds and reported tornadoes tore off roofs, uprooted trees and rendered rural roads impassable with debris

title: Getting Married Could Lower Your Cancer Risk, Researchers Say
desc: A recent study shows there may be a connection between those who are or have been married and reduced incidents of cancer. Experts note that marriage may decrease the odds of cancer, but doesn't prevent it.

title: Britain First Manchester protest LIVE updates as trams suspended and demonstrators face off amid huge police operation
desc: Hundreds of officers were deployed to police the march and rally. Counter protests were being held nearby as Britain First demonstrators gathered.

desc: Report and free match highlights as Leeds ease to dominant 3-0 win over Wolves; goals from James Justin, Noah Okafor and Dominic Calvert-Lewin put Leeds nine pints clear of relegation zone; Wolves relegation all but confirmed by latest defeat

title: India summons Iran envoy after attack on oil tanker in Hormuz
desc: Indian ship ‘Sanmar Herald’ is attacked while crossing Strait of Hormuz, source says; crew and vessel are safe

title: Metro air unhealthy as Navotas landfill fire blazes
desc: RESIDENTS in seven Metro Manila cities are breathing unhealthy air as a result of the ongoing blaze at the Navotas sanitary landfill, which started April 10, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) warned on Saturday.

title: Gabby Thomas as Ferdinand Omanyala seal 100m titles in Addis Ababa
desc: Olympic champion Thomas claimed a sprint double in the women's while Africa’s fastest man Omanyala stormed to the fourth fastest time this season in the men's 100m.

title: Nollywood Actor Mr Latin Earns BSc Degree from NOUN
desc: Veteran Nollywood actor Bolaji Amusan, popularly known as Mr Latin, celebrates his graduation from the National Open University of Nigeria (NOUN).
